title: Change drop ores
description: Ores are a fundamental part of Minecraft, but after playing for a long time, you can sometimes get tired of the loot they drop
body: Ores are a fundamental part of Minecraft, but after playing for a long time, you can sometimes get tired of the loot they drop. This datapack will attempt to fix this problem by updating ore drops! Now, in addition to the corresponding resource, ores will also drop the corresponding stone! Iron and gold ore will also drop nuggets. The odds and amount of resource drops with luck have also been slightly adjusted.
